svg.title: Contact — the event horizon
svg.desc: The profile ends at a black hole: a white-hot accretion disk spins around a black shadow, its far side bent up over the top by gravity into a glowing halo, with a thin photon ring, blue jets from the poles and matter spiralling in until it vanishes at the horizon. Below it: Let's build — AI systems, agentic architectures, backend systems, ambitious products; open to collaborations, opportunities and ambitious builds. The GitHub, Portfolio, LinkedIn, Kovidam and Email buttons directly below this image are real links.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: YOU HAVE REACHED THE EVENT HORIZON
